bull.point: ROCE improved significantly to 63.0% compared to 49% five years ago.
Revenue growth accelerated to 14.0% YoY in the quarter ending June 2026.
Management expressed confidence that growth momentum will continue based on TCV, pipeline, and client conversations.
bull.evidence: Looking at the TCV, pipeline and client conversations, we're confident that growth momentum will continue on a medium-term basis.

bear.point: PAT declined to 10,720.0 Cr in December 2025 despite stable revenue of 67,087.0 Cr.
Analysts raised concerns about the sustainability of international business growth momentum.
bear.evidence: Sustainability of international business growth momentum in coming quarters

bear.point: Management acknowledged macro and geopolitical uncertainties impacting near-term demand.
bear.evidence: Impact of macro and geopolitical uncertainties on near-term demand
